title: Ticket anlegen
description: As a support agent, I want to create a ticket with title, description and priority, so that a support request is captured and trackable.

acceptance_criteria.when: POST /api/v1/tickets with title 'Login failed', priority 'high', description 'cannot log in'
acceptance_criteria.then: 201 Created with ticket containing id, title, description, priority=high, status=open, created_at, updated_at

acceptance_criteria.when: POST /api/v1/tickets with title longer than 200 characters

acceptance_criteria.then: 201 Created with description null or empty
